role: RecordView extension: one computed property per Record-stack section with its visibility gate (the interrupted-workout cards outside activeSessionSection), the acceptance Save/Discard card, the morning and quick results full-screen covers, and the small callbacks they use (discard, finish, re-trim recovered workout).
types: RecordView: extension — section builders, results covers and callbacks

units.does: Card 'Save this reading?' with explanatory text and the Discard/Save buttons.
HStack with the red Discard button (readingDiscardButton, which confirms first) and prominent 'Save' (acceptSession).

The one message for discarding a reading awaiting review (rejectSession): it is discarded and left out of the baseline; if it was already saved it moves to the Trash, restorable from Settings → iCloud & Data → Trash; a night that was in the history before this recording stays as it was. Used by the acceptance card and the morning report's Discard.
Red bordered destructive 'Discard' that sets confirmingReadingDiscard; the confirmation ('Discard this reading?', with readingDiscardMessage) calls rejectSession on its destructive Discard.
units.entry: Button tap by user; Discard in the confirmation

units.does: Shows the RecordSessionSelector (quick/overnight/nap) bound to selectedSessionType when no session is active.
Shows RecordSelectedSessionHeader with a Change button (clearSelectedSession) when a type is chosen and no session is active.
Shows ReadingTagSelector (toggle via toggleTag, More opens the tag picker sheet) when a type is chosen and no session is active.

Shows ConnectionPanel when a type is selected, not overnight streaming, not awaiting acceptance, no morning status (which covers the strap download, .fetchingDevice), the type needs a strap (overnight/nap/quick — always true for the selectable types) and not already streaming.

branches.effect: false: nothing; true: evaluate the strap check

units.does: Shows RecoverableDataCard (Recover → recoverStoredData, Discard → discardAndStartFresh) when connected, the strap holds unrecovered or orphaned data, no failed fetch, not awaiting acceptance, not streaming/collecting, no fetch in progress and no morning status.

branches.cond: connected && offersStrapRecovery && !fetchFailed && !needsAcceptance && !isStreaming && !isCollecting && fetchProgress == nil && morningStatus == nil

units.does: When connected or paused, no morning status, and a type selected: shows the retry, continue-recovery and overnight sections unless quick-streaming, then the quick-reading section. The interrupted-workout cards are in workoutRecoverySection.

branches.effect: false: whole section hidden; true: continue
true: retry/continue/overnight subsections; false (quick streaming): only quickReadingSectionIfSelected

units.does: When fetchFailed, shows RetryFetchCard with retrying state, connection state, humanized last error, and Retry/Cancel/Dismiss callbacks.
Cancels the active Polar fetch and clears isRetrying.
Dismisses a failed fetch: fetchFailed=false, collector.resetSession(), selectedSessionType=nil.

Interrupted-workout strap-recovery card and recovered-workout review card, shown with or without a connected strap or selected session type; hidden only while the morning card runs or a quick reading streams.

branches.effect: true: both cards (each with its own gate); false: hidden

units.does: Shows the workout strap-recovery card when an interrupted workout id is known and no recovered-workout review is pending.
Shows RecoveredWorkoutReviewCard for a pending review with recoveredWorkoutFailure as its failure message; Save → keepRecoveredWorkout(endSec), Discard → discardRecoveredWorkout.
For overnight/nap selections when not streaming or paused, shows the Continue Recovery card for sessionState.recentPausedSession.
Shows the overnight recording panel for overnight or nap selections.
Shows the quick reading panel for the quick selection.
While morningStatus is set, shows MorningProcessingCard; skip-device-fetch sets deviceFetchPolicy=.skipByUser and cancels the fetch, skip-sleep-wait sets morningProcessingService.skipSleepWait=true.
Shows LiveDataPanel during quick streaming only (not overnight, no morning status).
Shows RecordVerificationSection with the verification result, the recovery window and the limits that result was verified against (verificationLimits) when a verification result exists.

branches.effect: true: section; false: nothing. Quick readings set verificationResult and needsAcceptance=false, so it shows next to QuickResultsCard too

units.does: The Verification.Config the shown result was verified against: the collector's relaxed streaming verifier's config for a quick reading (only quick streaming verifies .quick sessions, RRCollector+Streaming), otherwise the overnight verifier's config.
units.entry: SwiftUI evaluates it as part of verificationSectionIfPending

branches.effect: true: streamingVerification.config (120 beats, warn 10%); false: verification.config (default, 300 beats, warn 5%)

units.does: For a non-overnight/non-nap session awaiting acceptance with a result, shows morningResultsPreview.

branches.cond: needsAcceptance && currentSession with result && type not overnight/nap
branches.effect: true: preview; false: nothing. needsAcceptance is only set true by device-recording, morning-processing and finalize-from-pause paths (RRCollector+DeviceRecording.swift, +MorningProcessing.swift, +PauseResume.swift), which UI-start only overnight/nap; reachable only for a recovered session whose persisted type is something else

units.does: For a complete session not awaiting acceptance with a result (quick readings, which publish needsAcceptance=false), shows QuickResultsCard with View Report and Done.
Loads up to 28 prior overnight sessions before the reading into cachedRecentSessions, then sets quickPresentation to open the quick results cover.
Done on a finished quick reading (the card, and via resetAfterQuickReading the report): resets the collector session and clears tags, notes and selected type. Saves and scores nothing more.
Shows the Save/Discard acceptance card for non-overnight/non-nap sessions awaiting acceptance.

branches.cond: needsAcceptance && currentSession type exists and is not overnight/nap
branches.effect: true: acceptanceSection; false: nothing (same narrow reachability as morningResultsPreviewSection)

units.does: NavigationStack wrapping the morning results (with sleep-edit alert, the tag-save failure alert and the error alert, both always shown here) and a Done toolbar.
Adds the 'Sleep edit not saved' alert bound to sleepEditSaveFailed around morningResults.
Localized title 'Sleep edit not saved'.

Builds MorningResultsView for the presentation with cached recent sessions and callbacks: discard (its confirmation is readingDiscardMessage, the acceptance card's words for the same rejectSession), reanalyze (the saved-session reanalysis), the report's Tags & Notes edits (saveReportTags: onto the in-memory reading and its archived copy), reanalyze at position, apply manual result, update sleep and unlink segment (the reanalysis service), adjust sleep (with failure alert), and the linked segments read off-main when the report was presented (presentation.linkedSegments).
Rejects the reading (discardMorningReading → rejectSession) and closes the morning cover.
Applies a manual analysis window via ReanalysisService.applyManualAnalysis and returns the updated session.

Starts persisting a user sleep-boundary adjustment through the reanalysis service (off the main actor, in the order edits are made); once its task reports false, shows the 'Sleep edit not saved' alert.
Confirmation toolbar 'Done' → finishMorningReading.
Accepts the reading (acceptSession) and closes the morning cover.

NavigationStack wrapping quick results (with the tag-save failure alert and the error alert, both always shown here) with a Done toolbar and the 'Couldn't delete this reading' alert bound to quickDiscardFailed.
OK (cancel role) button for the delete-failed alert.

Builds MorningResultsView for a quick reading with discard (its confirmation says the reading moves to the Trash and can be restored), Tags & Notes edits (saveReportTags) and an update-sleep callback through the reanalysis service.

Deletes the quick reading from the archive and uploads a CloudKit deletion, then resets UI state; when the delete throws it logs, sets quickDiscardFailed (alert over the still-open report) and resets nothing.

branches.effect: logged; quickDiscardFailed = true; return (report stays open, reading still archived)

units.does: Closes the quick cover and runs clearFinishedQuickReading (session reset, tags, notes and type cleared).

The quick report's Done: resetAfterQuickReading (closes the cover and does what the card's Done does). Saves and scores nothing: the reading was archived with its tags at stop and carries no recovery score.
units.entry: Toolbar button in the quick results cover.

units.does: Animated scroll to the 'recordTop' anchor.
Animated reset of selectedSessionType to nil.

Clears interruptedWorkoutId and recoveredWorkoutFailure, then asynchronously re-trims the recovered workout to endSec via the collector; when that reports the card stayed up (nothing saved) it sets recoveredWorkoutFailure to 'Couldn't save the trimmed workout. Try again.'

Clears interruptedWorkoutId and recoveredWorkoutFailure and has the collector discard the recovered workout; when the delete failed it sets recoveredWorkoutFailure to 'Couldn't delete this workout. Try again.'
